intro: に反して (にはんして) means "going against X". Picture an arrow that was expected to point one way and points the other: the result runs against an expectation, a wish or a rule. The noun before it is always something that sets a direction, never a person or a thing being compared.

skills.rule: Expectation, wish or rule + に反して: the result goes against it ("contrary to", "against").
skills.explain:
に反して follows a small set of nouns that state what should or was supposed to happen: 予想, 期待, 予報, 希望, 意志, 意図, and rules such as 規則, 法律, 約束. 予想に反して is "contrary to expectations"; 本人の意志に反して is "against one's own will". The second half reports what actually happened.

Before a noun it becomes に反する or に反した: 期待に反する結果 (a result that went against expectations). As a predicate, 規則に反する means "violates the rules".

Do not put a person before it: "against my parents' wishes" is 親の希望に反して, not 親に反して. To set two sides side by side ("my brother is tall, whereas I am short"), use のに対して; に反して is for a broken expectation or rule. It is fairly formal; in conversation 思ったより or 予想と違って often replaces it.
patterns: [予想 / 期待 / 予報] に反して [actual result]
[someone's 意志 / 希望] に反して [action]

examples.jp: 予想[よそう]{にはんして}、テストは簡単[かんたん]だった。
examples.en: Contrary to expectations, the test was easy.

examples.jp: 天気[てんき]予報[よほう]{にはんして}、一日中[いちにちじゅう]晴[は]れていた。
examples.en: Contrary to the weather forecast, it was sunny all day.

examples.jp: 親[おや]の希望[きぼう]{にはんして}、兄[あに]は音楽家[おんがくか]になった。
examples.en: Against our parents' wishes, my brother became a musician.

examples.jp: みんなの期待[きたい]{にはんして}、チームは一回戦[いっかいせん]で負[ま]けた。
examples.en: Contrary to everyone's expectations, the team lost in the first round.

examples.jp: 本人[ほんにん]の意志[いし]{にはんして}、転勤[てんきん]が決[き]まった。
examples.en: The transfer was decided against the employee's own will.

examples.jp: それは会社[かいしゃ]の規則[きそく]{にはんする}行為[こうい]です。
examples.en: That is conduct that goes against company rules.

contrast.note: に対して sets two sides against each other (兄は背が高いのに対して、弟は低い) or names a target (客に対して丁寧だ). It does not mean the result defied an expectation.
に比べて compares degree: 去年に比べて暑い (hotter than last year). No expectation is broken.
に従って is the opposite direction: going along with a rule or wish. 規則に従う obeys; 規則に反する breaks.

mistakes.bad: 親[おや]{にはんして}留学[りゅうがく]した。
mistakes.good: 親[おや]の希望[きぼう]{にはんして}留学[りゅうがく]した。
mistakes.note: A person is not something you can go contrary to; name their wish or will.

mistakes.bad: 去年[きょねん]{にはんして}、今年[ことし]の夏[なつ]は暑[あつ]い。
mistakes.good: 去年[きょねん]{にくらべて}、今年[ことし]の夏[なつ]は暑[あつ]い。
mistakes.note: Last year is not an expectation that was broken; comparing degree is に比べて.

skills.tip: Can you put "contrary to what was expected or wanted" in front? Then に反して. If you are just setting A beside B, に対して.
